title: The coefficient-degree comparison respects the ideal tensor pairing
statement: Let $j:Z\to X$ be any morphism of schemes, let $L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module, and let $n,e\geq0$ [lem-sc-square-zero-ideal-tensor-unit]. Put $J=\ker(j)$, $P=\mathrm{tensorPullback}(j)$, $F=P(J\otimes L^n)$, $N=(PL)^n$, $a=n(e+1)$, $b=n(0+1)$, $c=n((e+1)+1)$. Define $m:L^a\otimes(J\otimes L^b)\to J\otimes L^c$ by reassociating, braiding $L^a$ past $J$, reassociating back, applying $J\otimes(\mathrm{tensorPowAddIso}_{a,b})^{-1}$ and the arithmetic identification $a+b=c$. For every open $V$ in $Z$, $q\in\Gamma(V,PL^a)$ and $s\in\Gamma(V,P(J\otimes L^b))$, applying boundaryCoefficientDegreeIso at e+1 to $P(m)((\mathrm{boundaryPullbackTensorIso}_{L^a,J\otimes L^b})^{-1}(q\otimes s))$ gives $\rho_F(\mathrm{boundaryCoefficientDegreeIso}_0(s))\otimes\mathrm{boundarySectionDegreeIso}_e(q)$. This concerns only tensor identifications, with no kernel map, lift or square-zero hypothesis.

proof.text: Use tensorPowAddIso_inv_block_interchange for the invertible L. Expand boundaryIdealTensorProduct and the braiding hexagon to factor it as the braiding of L^a with J tensor L^b, followed by coefficient-first concatenation. Combine the arithmetic casts to identify the target with L^c.

Map this factorization through tensorPullback. Apply boundaryCoefficientDegreeIso_split to the coefficient-first concatenation; apply boundaryPullbackTensorIso_braiding to the remaining braiding. The result is a morphism equality: the original pairing followed by C_{e+1} equals the input tensorator followed by braiding and the tensor of C_0 followed by rho with S_e.

Evaluate the morphism equality on the inverse tensorator applied to tmulSection q s. Cancel the tensorator and its inverse on sections. The braiding interchanges q and s, and tensorHom_app_tmulSection evaluates the tensor of the two comparison maps. This is exactly the displayed equality. All arithmetic equality proofs are irrelevant; zero degrees and empty opens use the same isomorphism identities.

theorem boundaryCoefficientDegreeIso_tensor_product {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Z ⟶ X)
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (n e : ℕ) (V : Z.Opens)
    (q : Γ((tensorPullback j).obj (L.tensorPow (n * (e + 1))), V))
    (s : Γ((tensorPullback j).obj (j.ker.toModules ⊗ L.tensorPow (n * (0 + 1))), V)) :
    let a := n * (e + 1)
    let b := n * (0 + 1)
    let c := n * ((e + 1) + 1)
    let m := boundaryIdealTensorProduct j.ker.toModules L a b ≫
      j.ker.toModules ◁ (eqToHom (by
        dsimp [a, b, c]
        congr 1
        simp only [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]) : L.tensorPow (a + b) ⟶ L.tensorPow c)
    (boundaryCoefficientDegreeIso j L n (e + 1)).hom.app V
        (((tensorPullback j).map m).app V
          ((boundaryPullbackTensorIso j (L.tensorPow a)
            (j.ker.toModules ⊗ L.tensorPow b)).inv.app V (tmulSection q s))) =
      tmulSection
        ((ρ_ ((tensorPullback j).obj (j.ker.toModules ⊗ L.tensorPow n))).hom.app V
          ((boundaryCoefficientDegreeIso j L n 0).hom.app V s))
        ((boundarySectionDegreeIso j L n e).hom.app V q)
